svg.title: Contract Risk Analyser — RAG Architecture
svg.desc: Full data flow diagram from PDF upload through RAG retrieval to risk dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the PDF upload work in the contract analyser?')
sendPrompt('How does the PDF parser work with PyMuPDF and Tesseract?')
sendPrompt('How does the clause splitter work with regex and LLM fallback?')
sendPrompt('How does sentence-transformers convert a clause to a vector?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in ChromaDB and how are benchmarks built?')
sendPrompt('How does Qwen3.5 analyse a clause and return structured JSON?')
sendPrompt('What does the JSON risk analysis object look like for each clause?')
sendPrompt('How does the health score aggregator calculate the final score?')
sendPrompt('What gets stored in Supabase in the contract analyser?')
sendPrompt('What does the results dashboard show to the user?')
sendPrompt('How is the PDF export report generated?')
